```yaml
name: Claude Code
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: 'Issue number to address'
        required: true
        type: number
      instructions:
        description: 'Additional instructions for Claude Code (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check if user is collaborator
        id: check_collaborator
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const actor = context.actor;
            
            try {
              await github.rest.repos.checkCollaborator({
                owner: owner,
                repo: repo,
                username: actor
              });
              console.log(`${actor} is a collaborator`);
              return true;
            } catch (error) {
              console.log(`${actor} is not a collaborator`);
              throw new Error('Only repository collaborators can trigger this workflow');
            }

      - name: Checkout code
        if: steps.check_collaborator.outputs.result == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        if: steps.check_collaborator.outputs.result == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.check_collaborator.outputs.result == 'true'
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: steps.check_collaborator.outputs.result == 'true'
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}
          INSTRUCTIONS: ${{ github.event.inputs.instructions }}
        run: |
          # This step would typically call Claude Code API
          # For now, we'll simulate the process
          echo "Running Claude Code analysis for issue #${ISSUE_NUMBER}"
          echo "Instructions: ${INSTRUCTIONS}"
          
          # In a real implementation, this would:
          # 1. Fetch the issue details
          # 2. Analyze the codebase with Claude Code
          # 3. Generate fixes
          # 4. Create a draft PR
          
          echo "Claude Code workflow completed successfully"

      - name: Create Draft Pull Request
        if: steps.check_collaborator.outputs.result == 'true' && success()
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: 'chore: Claude Code automated fix for issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}'
          title: 'Automated Fix: Issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}'
          body: |
            This is an automated draft PR created by Claude Code.
            
            Fixes issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}
            
            ${{
              github.event.inputs.instructions != '' 
              ? 'Additional instructions: ' + github.event.inputs.instructions 
              : ''
            }}
            
            Please review and approve before merging.
          branch: claude-code-fix-${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}
          draft: true
          delete-branch: true
```
